name: Quartermaster Yeva
title: The Kit Cage
examine: Every buckle on her is oiled and every blade on the rack is hers until you pay. Rust, in her cage, is a moral failing.
lines: Dry boots, sharp steel, shut mouth. Two of those are sold here.
Bring the kit back clean or bring coin for the next one. The Company forgives blood, not rust.
The blades get first pick. Friends of the Company get second. Everyone else gets the road.
